demo.title: A Glimpse of Mirael
demo.subtitle: See how Mirael reflects emotions with clarity and care.

conversation.text: I feel stuck and weighed down by everything.
It sounds heavy. What feels like the hardest part to carry right now?
Mostly pressure at work. I can’t seem to shut it off at night.
So the pressure follows you even after work ends. That sounds exhausting. When it shows up at night, what do you notice in yourself?
My mind keeps racing. I replay conversations and worry I should have done more.
It seems like you hold yourself to very high standards. Where do you feel that pressure most strongly right now? In your body or in your thoughts?
Mostly in my chest. Like a tightness I can’t release.
That tightness tells me your body is carrying the stress as much as your mind. What happens if you pause and give that feeling a moment of attention?
It feels uncomfortable, like I want to avoid it.
Avoiding makes sense when something feels overwhelming. But noticing it gently can be the first step to easing its grip. Would you like to try that together?

items.question: What is Mirael?
items.answer: Mirael is an emotional mirror. It helps you slow down, reflect, and see your inner world with more clarity through short, emotionally attuned conversations.

items.question: How is Mirael different from therapy?
items.answer: Mirael is not therapy and cannot replace professional care. It is a daily reflective companion designed to support awareness, not to diagnose or treat mental health conditions.

items.question: How does Mirael actually work?
items.answer: Mirael uses carefully designed prompts and conversational patterns to reflect emotions back to you. It highlights hidden pressures, recurring thoughts, and unspoken rules so you can better understand yourself.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answer: Yes. Your reflections belong to you. Conversations are private by design, and you will have the ability to export or delete your data.

items.question: Who is Mirael for?
items.answer: Mirael is built for people who carry a lot, often appear strong on the outside, but feel emotionally drained inside. It offers them a safe space to reflect, recognize patterns, and reclaim clarity.

items.question: Can Mirael help in a crisis?
items.answer: No. Mirael is not a crisis service. If you are in immediate danger or facing a mental health emergency, please contact local emergency services or a professional hotline.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: During early access, Mirael is free to use. Pricing will be introduced later as we grow with feedback from early users.

items.question: Why should I join early access?
items.answer: Early access lets you shape Mirael with us. Your feedback will directly influence how the experience evolves, and you will be among the first to benefit from new features.
